t: This is the Margaret McMillan Nursery School in Islington, named after Margaret McMillan, a pioneer of nursery education. She worked in deprived districts of London, notably Deptford, and in Bradford, pushing for reforms to improve young children's health. She lobbied for the 1906 Provision of School Meals Act and wrote several books on nursery education. Her play-centred approach has only latterly found wide acceptance, which makes it fitting that a nursery school carries her name.
